parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: This is the seat of a folding chair, typically made of durable plastic or polymer material. It is flat and designed to support the user's weight.
parts.Functional_description: The seat provides the main sitting surface for the user, distributing body weight evenly and ensuring comfort during use.
parts.Movement_description: The seat can pivot upward when the chair is folded and downward when unfolded for sitting.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the folding chair, made of tubular steel for strength and stability.
parts.Functional_description: The base body supports the seat and backrest, providing structural integrity and allowing the folding mechanism to function.
parts.Movement_description: The base body includes pivot joints that allow the chair to fold flat for storage and unfold for use.
